items.source: Returns null if no Method can be found.
items.translation: 如果找不到任何 Method，则返回 null。

items.translation: 尝试在提供的Class上查找具有提供的name的field。搜索从该Class到Object的所有父类。

items.source: Pre-built ReflectionUtils.MethodFilter that matches all non-bridge non-synthetic methods which are not declared on java.lang.Object.
items.translation: 预构建的ReflectionUtils.MethodFilter，用于匹配所有非桥接、非合成方法，且这些方法未声明在java.lang.Object上。

items.source:

Leaf class methods are included first and while traversing the superclass hierarchy
any methods found with signatures matching a method already included are filtered out.
items.translation: 获取叶类及其所有父类中声明的唯一方法集。首先包含叶类的方法，并在遍历父类层次结构时，过滤掉与已包含方法的签名匹配的任何方法。

items.source: Rethrows the underlying exception cast to a RuntimeException or Error if appropriate; otherwise, throws an UndeclaredThrowableException.
items.translation: 重新抛出底层异常，将其转换为 RuntimeException 或（如适用）Error；否则，抛出 UndeclaredThrowableException。

items.source: Rethrows the underlying exception cast to an Exception or Error if appropriate; otherwise, throws an UndeclaredThrowableException.
items.translation: 重新抛出底层异常，将其转换为 Exception 或（如适用）Error；否则，抛出 UndeclaredThrowableException。

items.source: The same named method occurring on subclass and superclass will appear twice, unless excluded by a ReflectionUtils.MethodFilter.
items.translation: 子类中出现的同名方法将显示两次，除非被ReflectionUtils.MethodFilter排除。

items.source: The same named method occurring on subclass and superclass will appear twice, unless excluded by the specified ReflectionUtils.MethodFilter.
items.translation: 子类中出现的同名方法将显示两次，除非被指定的ReflectionUtils.MethodFilter排除。

items.source: In accordance with Field.set(Object, Object) semantics, the new value is automatically unwrapped if the underlying field has a primitive type.
items.translation: 根据Field.set(Object, Object)的语义，如果底层字段是基本类型，新值会自动解包。

items.source:

by a target method, or if an error occurs while accessing a method or field.
items.translation: 仅当预期目标方法不会抛出受检异常，或在访问方法或字段时发生错误时才应调用。

items.source:
Throws the underlying RuntimeException or Error in case of an
InvocationTargetException with such a root cause. Throws an
IllegalStateException with an appropriate message or
UndeclaredThrowableException otherwise.
items.translation: 在遇到具有此类根本原因的 InvocationTargetException 时，抛出底层的 RuntimeException 或 Error。否则，抛出带有适当消息的 IllegalStateException 或 UndeclaredThrowableException。

items.source:
Throws the underlying RuntimeException or Error in case of such a root

items.translation: 在存在此类根本原因时，抛出底层的 RuntimeException 或 Error；否则抛出 UndeclaredThrowableException。

items.source: Attempt to find a field on the supplied Class with the supplied name and/or type. Searches all superclasses up to Object.

items.source: Determine whether the given method is originally declared by Object.
items.translation: 确定给定方法是否最初由 `Object` 声明。

items.source: Variant of Class.getDeclaredMethods() that uses a local cache in order to avoid new Method instances. In addition, it also includes Java 8 default methods from locally implemented interfaces, since those are effectively to be treated just like declared methods.
items.translation: `Class.getDeclaredMethods()` 的变体，使用本地缓存以避免创建新的 `Method` 实例。此外，它还包括从本地实现的接口中获取的 Java 8 默认方法，因为这些方法应被视为与声明的方法相同。

items.source: Make the given constructor accessible, explicitly setting it accessible if necessary. The setAccessible(true) method is only called when actually necessary, to avoid unnecessary conflicts.
items.translation: 使给定的构造函数可访问，必要时显式设置其可访问性。setAccessible(true) 方法仅在必要时调用，以避免不必要的冲突。

items.source: Make the given method accessible, explicitly setting it accessible if necessary. The setAccessible(true) method is only called when actually necessary, to avoid unnecessary conflicts.
items.translation: 使给定方法可访问，必要时显式设置其可访问性。仅在确实需要时才调用 `setAccessible(true)` 方法，以避免不必要的冲突。

items.source: Make the given field accessible, explicitly setting it accessible if necessary. The setAccessible(true) method is only called when actually necessary, to avoid unnecessary conflicts.
items.translation: 使给定字段可访问，必要时显式设置其可访问性。仅在确实必要时才调用 `setAccessible(true)` 方法，以避免不必要的冲突。

items.source:
Determine whether the given method explicitly declares the given
exception or one of its superclasses, which means that an exception
of that type can be propagated as-is within a reflective invocation.
items.translation: 确定给定方法是否显式声明了给定的异常或其超类之一，这意味着该类型的异常可以在反射调用中按原样传播。

items.translation: 在给定类的本地声明字段上调用给定的回调。

items.source:
Perform the given callback operation on all matching methods of the given
class, as locally declared or equivalent thereof (such as default methods
on Java 8 based interfaces that the given class implements).
items.translation: 对给定类的所有匹配方法执行给定的回调操作，这些方法包括本地声明的方法或等效方法（例如基于 Java 8 的接口中的默认方法，且给定类实现了该接口）。

items.source: Get the unique set of declared methods on the leaf class and all superclasses.
items.translation: 获取叶类及其所有父类的声明方法的唯一集合。

following the pattern "CGLIB$methodName$0".
items.translation: 判断给定方法是否为 CGLIB“重命名”方法，其模式为"CGLIB$methodName$0"。

items.source: Determine whether the given method is an "equals" method.

or a subclass, copy all fields, including inherited fields. Designed to
work on objects with public no-arg constructors.
items.translation: 给定源对象和目的地（必须是同一类或其子类），复制所有字段，包括继承的字段。设计用于具有公共无参构造函数的对象。
